Private Function Safe(ByVal target As Object, ByVal name As String) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Safe = CallByName(target, name, VbGet)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Safe = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal kind As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, cf As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("J1:J3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("a", "b", "c"))
    Set cf = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(kind, 10, 10, 90, 60).ControlFormat
    If kind = xlDropDown Or kind = xlListBox Then cf.ListFillRange = "$J$1:$J$3"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        cf.Enabled = False
    Case 2
        cf.LockedText = False
    Case 3
        cf.PrintObject = False
    Case 4
        cf.Enabled = False: cf.Enabled = True
    Case 5
        cf.DropDownLines = 3
    Case 6
        cf.DropDownLines = 0
    Case 7
        cf.DropDownLines = -1
    Case 8
        cf.DropDownLines = 40000
    Case 9
        cf.ListIndex = 2
    Case 10
        cf.ListIndex = 0
    Case 11
        cf.ListIndex = 4
    Case 12
        cf.Value = 3
    Case 13
    Case 14
        cf.Enabled = False
    Case 15
        cf.LockedText = False
    Case 16
        cf.PrintObject = False
    Case 17
        cf.Enabled = False: cf.Enabled = True
    Case 18
        cf.DropDownLines = 3
    Case 19
        cf.DropDownLines = 0
    Case 20
        cf.DropDownLines = -1
    Case 21
        cf.DropDownLines = 40000
    Case 22
        cf.ListIndex = 2
    Case 23
        cf.ListIndex = 0
    Case 24
        cf.ListIndex = 4
    Case 25
        cf.Value = 3
    Case 26
    Case 27
        cf.Enabled = False
    Case 28
        cf.LockedText = False
    Case 29
        cf.PrintObject = False
    Case 30
        cf.Enabled = False: cf.Enabled = True
    Case 31
        cf.DropDownLines = 3
    Case 32
        cf.ListIndex = 1
    Case 33
    Case 34
        cf.Enabled = False
    Case 35
        cf.LockedText = False
    Case 36
        cf.PrintObject = False
    Case 37
        cf.Enabled = False: cf.Enabled = True
    Case 38
        cf.DropDownLines = 3
    Case 39
        cf.ListIndex = 1
    End Select
    s = Safe(cf, "DropDownLines") & "," & Safe(cf, "Enabled") & "," & Safe(cf, "ListIndex") & "," & Safe(cf, "LockedText") & "," & Safe(cf, "PrintObject")
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(0, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(1, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(2, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(3, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(4, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(5, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(6, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(7, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(8, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(9, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(10, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(11, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(12, xlDropDown, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(13, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(14, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(15, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(16, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(17, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(18, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(19, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(20, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(21, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(22, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(23, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(24, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(25, xlListBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(26, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(27, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(28, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(29, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(30, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(31, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(32, xlCheckBox, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(33, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(34, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(35, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(36, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(37, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(38, xlButtonControl, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(39, xlButtonControl, folder)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
